description: Register a domain. cost is integer US cents matching the current quote. dry_run defaults to true and makes no API call; execution requires dry_run=false, confirm_apply=true, agree_to_terms=true, write mode and domain-create enablement. Card execution requires a saved caller-generated idempotency_key. Reuse it only for identical retries; use a new key when adding card_payment_id. This tool never pays the link.
name: domains_create
